papers.title: NAMVIS: Next-Scale Autoregressive Multi-View Image Synthesis
papers.desc: Sparse-view novel view synthesis is a central problem in 3D content creation, but diffusion-based approaches remain limited by iterative denoising, making multi-view generation expensive at inference time.

papers.title: Q-Learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching
papers.desc: Flow policies capture rich and diverse action distributions, and fine-tuning them with off-policy RL to improve beyond the demonstrations has drawn growing interest.

papers.title: A self-learning scientific agent for X-ray diffraction
papers.desc: A central challenge for scientific agents is to turn analytical experience into reusable expertise grounded in physical evidence.

papers.title: MIMESIS: Learning User Simulators as Training Environments for Interactive Agents
papers.desc: Training and evaluating interactive language agents typically requires rich user interactions, yet collecting human feedback is expensive and difficult to scale.

papers.title: SheetSage2: Coherent Lead-Sheet Transcription with Synthetic Supervision
papers.desc: Transcribing music into a human-readable score requires a coherent understanding of rhythm, harmony, melody, and form.

papers.title: Iris-3B: Going Beyond the Latent with Pixel-Space Diffusion Training, Conversion and Fine-Tuning
papers.desc: Pixel-space diffusion models avoid the lossy VAE of latent models, which suggests an advantage on downstream tasks where fine-grained detail matters.

papers.title: Composing What Each Teacher Learned: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation through Teacher-Relative Shifts
papers.desc: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) is used in two settings.

papers.title: UniSkill: Learning Actor-Aligned Skill Proposals for an Evolving Policy
papers.desc: Large language model agents can improve across tasks by retaining reusable skills distilled from prior interactions.

papers.title: CoDance: Learning Reactive and Compliant Human-Humanoid Interaction from Video
papers.desc: Partnered human-humanoid interaction couples locomotion with continuous physical contact.

papers.title: FastOPD: On-Policy Distillation for Lightweight VLA Deployment
papers.desc: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models have scaled rapidly to enhance manipulation performance and generalizability, but this scaling incurs high computational costs that render real-world deployment increasingly challenging.

papers.title: Lineage-Aware Memory Governance: A Derivation-Gated Framework for Privacy-Preserving Column-Level Access Control in Enterprise AI Agents
papers.desc: Enterprise AI agents that share a memory store face two unaddressed risks: sensitive data can leak through legitimately computed results the requester could not derive, and departments can silently compute a same-named key performance indicator (KPI) through conflicting logic.

papers.title: PAMI: Part Anchored Motion for Text to Human-Object Interaction Generation
papers.desc: Text-conditioned full-body human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires synthesizing human motion and object trajectories that match the input text while remaining precisely coordinated over time.

papers.title: TIDES: Implicit Time-Awareness in Selective State Space Models
papers.desc: Selective state space models (SSMs), such as Mamba, achieve strong per-token expressivity by making the time discretization step TildeΔ a learned function of the input.

papers.title: How corner is a corner case? Percentile control for highway scenario generation
papers.desc: Generating corner-case scenarios with appropriate adversity in a simulation environment is critical for testing an autonomous vehicle (AV) software stack's safety performance before deployment.

papers.title: System Switch: When Should a Fast Decision Model Stop and Think?
papers.desc: Dual-process agents pair a fast policy with a slow deliberative model.
